title: Calcium–albumin coupling did not improve PTH prediction beyond flexible conventional measures across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A total-calcium × albumin product did not establish improved logPTH prediction beyond corrected calcium, flexible individual biomarkers and conventional covariates in exploratory NHANES2003–2004 to2005–2006 transfer (3,772 source; 3,781 target adults): weighted MSE difference 0.00017611 log(pg/mL)² (0.126%), jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.00055493,0.00465242].
